title: Doc: HOWTO.md missing mlock failure / RLIMIT_MEMLOCK operator guidance
description: The keystore load path (wp11_keystore.c) treats mlock failure as fatal — it returns WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_MLOCK rather than continuing with unlocked memory. This is intentional for security. However, HOWTO.md does not document this behavior. In containers and restricted environments, the default RLIMIT_MEMLOCK is often very low (64 KB on many distros), which will cause keystore load to silently fail if the key material size exceeds the limit. Operators will see a cryptic login failure with no indication of the root cause. Fix: add a section in HOWTO.md (or the deployment/container section) documenting: (1) mlock failure is fatal by design, (2) the symptom is C_Login returning CKR_GENERAL_ERROR or similar, (3) operators must raise RLIMIT_MEMLOCK (ulimit -l or CAP_IPC_LOCK in containers), (4) minimum required limit calculation based on keystore size.
